The Concept

Roseburg's Missing
Family Destination

Families in the Roseburg area deserve a place built just for them — an indoor escape for rainy days, birthday adventures, and spontaneous fun. Umpqua Adventure Park blends the rugged spirit of the Pacific Northwest with thrilling play experiences designed for kids ages 2–14 and the parents who love watching them thrive.

Our Pacific Northwest forest theme brings together Sasquatch legend and dinosaur wonder into a single unforgettable destination — one your kids will beg to return to.

🌲

Built for the PNW

Inspired by Oregon's forests, wildlife lore, and the adventurous families who call this region home. Every corner tells a story.

What's Inside

Every Zone, An Adventure

Five distinct play environments, one roof. Designed so there's always something new to discover — and a reason to come back.

🦕

Dinosaur Playground

A multi-level climbing structure wrapped in prehistoric theming — tunnels, slides, bridges, and fossil discoveries at every turn.

30 × 60 ft
🏃

Ninja Warrior Course

Dual-lane, side-by-side racing with modular obstacles that change over time. Built for competition, bragging rights, and repeat visits.

20 × 80 ft · Dual Lane

Sasquatch Toddler Zone

A safe, padded world designed for the littlest adventurers — soft climbing, sensory play, and Sasquatch-sized fun for under-5s.

Coming to Your Community

Roseburg Was
Made for This

We're actively evaluating spaces in the Roseburg area to find the perfect home for Umpqua Adventure Park. Our target: a high-visibility, easily accessible location with room to grow.

Why Roseburg?

  • Strong local family market with limited indoor alternatives
  • Year-round rainy-day demand — indoor entertainment is essential
  • I-5 corridor access draws visitors from the broader region
  • Community-first culture that supports local businesses

Target Space

  • 6,000–10,000 sq ft retail or flex space
  • 12–18 ft ceiling clearance for multi-level play structures
  • Ample on-site parking
  • High foot traffic corridor preferred
